name: ai-marketing-autopilot
description: AI-powered marketing automation platform - Generate strategies, content calendars, social posts & Reels scripts
author: Sanyla

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter web dev & pnpm --filter api start:dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.start: pnpm --filter api start:prod & pnpm --filter web start
scripts.db:migrate: cd prisma && pnpm prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd prisma && pnpm prisma db push
scripts.db:reset: cd prisma && pnpm prisma migrate reset
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm docker:up && sleep 5 && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed
